text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data sent between users and servers. Strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor verification, helps ensure that only the right people can access accounts. Input validation is also important: it checks what users type into forms and blocks harmful code before it reaches the system. Developers must also learn about common vulnerabilities, like SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which attackers often try to exploit. By following these basic practices, developers can build safer websites and protect users from many online threats.
